questions.examName: Most Important Selected Qs for JEE Advanced
questions.q:
A hydrocarbon $\left(A\right)$ ${C}_{n}{H}_{2n - 4}$ on ozonolysis gives
${\left(C{H}_{3}\right)}_{2}CHC{H}_{2}CHO, OHCC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CHO$ and $C{H}_{3}COC{H}_{3}$ .
The value of n is
questions.solution:
Based on the formula of hydrocarbon ${C}_{n}{H}_{2n - 4}$ the degree of unsaturation is 3. So, there is two case:

(I) 3 double bonds

(II) 1 double bond and 1 triple bond

Second case can be easily rejected because products of ozonolysis are aldehyde or ketone rather than carboxylic acid.

So the alkene would be:

$( C{H}_{3}{)}_{2}CHC{H}_{2}CH = CHC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CH = CHC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CH = C{\left(C{H}_{3}\right)}_{2}$

Which on ozonolysis will give products as:

${\left(C{H}_{3}\right)}_{2}CHC{H}_{2}CH = CHC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CH = CHC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CH = C{\left(C{H}_{3}\right)}_{2}$

$\overset{Ozonolysis}{\to} ( C{H}_{3}{)}_{2}CHC{H}_{2}CHO + 2OHCC{H}_{2}C{H}_{2}CHO + C{H}_{3}COC{H}_{3}$

The formula of alkene is ${C}_{16}{H}_{28}$

So the value of ‘x’ is 16.

questions.q:
Consider the following compounds :
$C{H}_{4}, C{H}_{3} - C{H}_{3}, C{H}_{3}OH, C{H}_{3} - C{H}_{2} - C{H}_{3}, C{H}_{3} - C{H}_{2} - C{H}_{2} - C{H}_{2} - C{H}_{3}$



How many compounds can be prepared by Wurtz reaction in high yield?
questions.solution:
Only symmetrical alkanes are prepared using wurtz reaction.
So only ${CH}_{3} - {CH}_{3}$ and ${CH}_{3} - CH\mathop{{CH}_{3}}_{|} - CH\mathop{{CH}_{3}}_{|} - {CH}_{3}$ can be prepared using this reaction.
